title: Entravision Scales Industry-First AI Latino Radio Show "GeeGee & Coyotec" into 5 New Markets Across the Fuego Network
summary: Following audience growth in Los Angeles, the dynamic human-AI duo expands into a multi-market, English-infused bicultural format tailored for bilingual audiences. Entravision (NYSE: EVC), a leading media and advertising technology company, today announced the multi-market expansion of its groundbreaking AI-co-hosted show starring Geraldine "GeeGee" Guzman and Coyotec, the industry’s first Latino AI radio personality. Beginning Monday, August 3rd, the duo brings their signature chemistry, culture, and high-energy format to five new key markets across Entravision’s premier Fuego Network, which targets one of the fastest rising consumers: bicultural bilingual Latinos. GeeGee Coyotec is the first human-AI Latino personality show on a bilingual radio format.
